name: @webdesk/integrations
description: Integration adapters — GitHub/Google Workspace/Vercel background jobs remain interfaces only (Phase 1A). Real implementations: VercelBlobAdapter (Business Knowledge Center attachments), WordPressRestAdapter (REST API, Application Password auth), and the named WP-CLI actions in wp-cli-actions.ts (mechanism only — no real SSH executor wired in yet, WP-CLI/SSH provisioning is unconfirmed). See docs/contracts/*.md for the full contract each interface formalizes. Dual ESM+CJS build (dist/ + dist-cjs/) — required for dashboard-api's Vercel Function bundler, same as @webdesk/configuration/database/shared-types/validation (see CLAUDE.md's Cautions section).
